comment: The movement based instruction was pretty easy to follow and I got a lot out of this unique method of teaching. However, the lectures were often difficult to follow. I found myself struggling to take proper notes. The textbook is helpful if you really want to understand the anatomy taught. I learned a lot of anatomy which is what I hoped for!!

Hands down the worst professor I've had in college so far. Most classes consisted of her lecturing and spitting out a ton of anatomical terminology that most of us never understood, and then she would assume that certain students don't use their resources to help themselves on assignments they had for her class. She wasn't very helpful at all.
